top_categories.workout_context: Race-pace efforts that mimic L'Eroica's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before October.

Road-specific control matters at L'Eroica. Practice on tuscan hills — strade bianche: use smooth gear and cadence changes, accelerate deliberately out of corners, and settle quickly back into sustainable power for 131 miles.
97ft/mi signals a climbing-heavy course. Sustained sub-threshold and threshold work builds the steady power needed without turning the opening climb into the day’s hardest effort.
At L'Eroica, changes in grade or pace can lift effort above threshold before it settles again. Over-unders train that transition while you keep riding.
At mile 60 of 131, glycogen is gone. This workout teaches your body to produce watts on fumes.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of L'Eroica. Train it until it feels boring.
12,707ft of climbing on grades that change every minute. You need to switch from seated to standing without losing rhythm.
12,707ft of climbing makes aerobic ceiling relevant when the grade or pace changes. VO2max work supports those hard moments; sustained climbing and conservative pacing remain the spine.
Brief efforts above sustainable power can come from grade changes, positioning, or closing a gap at L'Eroica. Train them without letting those efforts derail the longer pacing plan.
Steeper ramps, positioning, or pace changes on tuscan hills — strade bianche can demand short hard efforts. Practice them without compromising the sustained work that defines the course.
Endurance with intensity spikes baked in. Exactly what 12,707ft of climbing on tuscan hills — strade bianche does to your power file on race day.
Low-cadence force work supports 12,707ft of climbing when the grade lowers cadence. Practice controlled torque while preserving good form.

race_overlay.nutrition: Target 60–80g carbs/hour for L'Eroica’s 131 miles. Start fueling within the first 30 minutes — early fueling prevents late-race collapse. Bonking at mile 60 is a nutrition failure, not a fitness failure.
race_overlay.terrain: Mixed terrain at L'Eroica requires surface adaptability. Include weekly rides on tuscan hills — strade bianche to build confidence.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on Race Simulation, Road Specific, and TT Threshold to prepare you for 131 miles of tuscan hills — strade bianche in Gaiole in Chianti, Siena, Tuscany.
